Mara Costa, a payments change_approver and not the author, gave a code_review approval.

summary: The change raises the Payments privileged idle timeout to 16 minutes, outside SES-1's bound. The deviation is covered by a valid, unexpired risk-owner exception (EXC-0224). Ticket, independent code review and control-owner approval are all in order on the head commit. However, the JUnit report attached to the CI run was produced on a personal machine at a time inconsistent with the run record. That leaves CHG-4 unestablished, so the change is held until a verifiable CI run on the head commit is supplied.
